request: Investigate why order ORD-1003 is delayed.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its status, promised delivery date, warehouse, and items.
I will check the shipment tracking to confirm current status, any delay reason, and whether it is overdue against the promised date.

shipments.recorded_delay_reason: Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm

events.description: Hub closed due to winter storm; revised ETA 2026-03-18

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1003 is delayed past its promised delivery date due to a carrier-reported hub closure. The shipment is 7 days late with a revised ETA of 2026-03-18.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1003 fulfillment_status SHIPPED from WH-CHI, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-09, is_past_promised_date true
get_shipment_status: shipment SHP-5003 via Great Lakes Freight status DELAYED, tracking GLF-88231, is_overdue true, days_past_promised_date 7
get_shipment_status: recorded_delay_reason "Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm"
get_shipment_status: events include DELAY at Toledo, OH on 2026-03-07 and DEPARTED_HUB on 2026-03-12; days_since_last_event 4
arguments.likely_cause: Great Lakes Freight hub closure at Toledo, OH due to a winter storm, as recorded on the shipment.
uncertainties: No tracking scan since 2026-03-12 (4 days), so the 2026-03-18 ETA could change.

recommended_actions.details: Inform Contoso Hardware that shipment GLF-88231 is delayed due to a Great Lakes Freight hub closure at Toledo, OH and is now estimated to deliver on 2026-03-18; cite get_shipment_status (status DELAYED, recorded_delay_reason, revised ETA).

Contact Great Lakes Freight to request a trace/update on GLF-88231, confirming it departed Toledo on 2026-03-12 and is on track for the 2026-03-18 ETA given 4 days since the last scan; reference get_shipment_status (days_since_last_event 4, current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-18).
Monitor tracking for movement and delivery by 2026-03-18; if no update or missed ETA, escalate accordingly. Evidence: get_shipment_status shows revised ETA 2026-03-18 and last event on 2026-03-12.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer of the revised 2026-03-18 ETA and ask the carrier to confirm the shipment is on schedule; monitor tracking for delivery by the ETA.
